title: Go for the Eyes
description:
Deal 3 damage.
If the enemy intends to attack, apply 1 [gold]Weak[/gold].
upgraded_description:
Deal 4 damage.
If the enemy intends to attack, apply 2 [gold]Weak[/gold].
notes: Glows gold when targeting an enemy that intends to attack. The Weak debuff is only applied if the enemy intends to attack.
